_schema.about: Hand-maintained transcription of https://www.bridgebench.ai/leaderboard. A maintainer copies it from the site in a normal browser; scripts/build_leaderboard.py only reads this file and never contacts bridgebench.ai. Leave models empty until the data source and attribution terms are settled (issue #5).
_schema.source: URL the scores were read from
_schema.transcribed_at: ISO 8601 UTC time the scores were copied, e.g. 2026-10-05T12:00:00Z
_schema.models: [{rank: int (1 = best), name: BridgeBench display name, slug: BridgeBench URL slug, overall: number, axes: {axis_name: number, ...}}]
